ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.18.2-P1 is a diagnostic-only profiler build based directly on the validated V0.4.18.2 aggressive playtest. Gameplay optimization behavior is intentionally unchanged. It adds hierarchical timing for DoSingleTick, Thing TickLists, map/game/world component ticks, WorldPawns, WorldObjects, Storyteller, LordManager, plus 1-in-16 sampled Pawn.Tick / Pawn_JobTracker / Pawn_PathFollower detail. Frame-side Root_Play.Update, MapUpdate, component-update and DynamicDraw timing is also recorded so simulation stalls can be separated from rendered-frame/update stalls. Reports include per-layer average, approximate P50/P95/P99, maximum and >16/32/64 ms counts. All timings are inclusive; nested rows are diagnostic evidence and should not be summed blindly. V0.4.18.2 ReachProfile, GenClosest, WorkPrefilter, haul acceleration and shadow-only path behavior remain unchanged.
